gui.cooking_cauldron.title: Boiling
description.concoction.concoction.magma_: An egg prepared in a rather unusual way. A raw egg is dropped straight into the blazing, still-hot lava and left to cook for a while. The shell turns black and hard as obsidian — bite carefully, or you might break your teeth... or scorch your tongue. The taste isn’t exactly pleasant: the egg is almost completely burned, leaving little but bitterness behind. Yet somehow, the yolk is cooked to absolute perfection! A bit of mint afterwards helps make the flavor more tolerable.
description.concoction.concoction.bacon_: Two eggs, fried on one side over medium heat. A light, golden-brown crust forms around the edges, while the slowly oozing yolk is a sight to behold. Lightly seared bacon on the side balances the flavor perfectly — crisp, with thin layers of savory fat. A simple, yet remarkably effective breakfast.
description.concoction.concoction.bamboo: Meat, slices of ham, and fresh bamboo shoots are simmered together for hours, allowing every texture and flavor to fully unfold. The ham soaks up the spicy broth infused with simmered hot peppers, while the tender bamboo adds a hint of refreshing lightness. A dish said to cure almost any ailment.
description.concoction.concoction.bucket: A mixed casserole made of whatever was on hand: milk, butter, meat, cabbage, potatoes — you name it! Everything got tossed together into a bucket and baked right in it, filling the air with a heavenly aroma. Through the cuts in the golden crust, you can glimpse juicy meat and tender vegetables. Just looking at this dish is enough to heal the soul.
description.concoction.concoction.butter: A piece of butter of decent quality. An ingredient used in many dishes. Enhances the flavor of almost any meal.

Thick slice of fresh, crusty bread, generously spread with soft, creamy butter. It won’t fill your belly, perhaps, but with a warm cup of tea—or something stronger—it’s just the thing to lift your spirits and chase away the chill.
description.concoction.concoction.cake_s: A slice of classic cake. The endlessly tempting aroma of sweet, soaked sponge calls to you, whispering—take another bite… and another… and another!... Until you realize there’s no room left for anything else.
description.concoction.concoction.cherry: A slice of cherry cake with chocolate. The sweet aroma of ripe cherries blends into a symphony of flavors with the soft, melting taste of chocolate. You can’t stop eating — it’s as if the grated chocolate gently mends your soul, binding you to every bite.

Crispy cookies the color of an early sunset — tender inside and barely crumbly, with a ripe cherry hidden at the center. Who ever said that food capable of healing the soul and delighting the stomach had to be hard to make?
Fresh cherries — sweet, juicy, and full of aroma. They’re enjoyed both raw and as an ingredient in all kinds of dishes. It’s said that treats made from them can heal the soul.
description.concoction.concoction.chicke: The name 'Confit' comes from a few distant villages known for their unique way of preserving meat. The chicken is first salted, then slowly cooked beneath a layer of fat. It pairs well with nearly any side dish and shines with a rich, savory flavor. The tender meat releases layers of aroma, while roasted vegetables perfectly complement the taste of the bird. The aroma alone heals your soul.
description.concoction.concoction.chocol: A slice of chocolate cake. Who would have thought that once-bitter chocolate could become so soft and sweet? The bitterness has vanished entirely, leaving behind a deep, sugary aftertaste and an irresistible urge to take another warm, molten bite… until there’s simply no room left for more.

A bar of bittersweet, glossy chocolate. An ingredient used in many dishes, yet its refined flavor is worth savoring on its own. It’s said that its sweetness helps fill the stomach with ease, while its bitterness helps gather experience—and keep it from slipping away.
description.concoction.concoction.corn_s: A beautiful dish that mirrors the warmth of the morning sun with its golden hue. The broth, thick and rich like liquid honey or molten gold, carries a gentle aroma and flavor that blends perfectly with the chicken simmered in it alongside fresh herbs. The meat turns out tender and juicy. A soup like this warms the body—and lightens any journey ahead.
description.concoction.concoction.cream_: A small bottle of fine-quality cream. An ingredient used in many dishes. It enriches and deepens the flavor of any meal.
description.concoction.concoction.dandel: It may be called tea, but in truth, it’s just a simple brew. Don’t let that fool you, though! Its gentle, warm floral aroma—like a summer meadow beside a hot spring—fills your lungs, while its faint bitterness refreshes and sharpens the mind. After such a pleasant drink, you’ll surely grow hungry again… after all, gaining experience is hard on an empty stomach.
description.concoction.concoction.fish_a: A simple yet tasty dish made by frying fish and potatoes in oil. The fish fillet is coated in flour and cooked until golden and crispy, while the potatoes are fried in a similar way, salted, and often seasoned with herbs or spices. Any sauce will do! After a meal like this, work seems just a bit easier.
description.concoction.concoction.fried_: A fresh egg, fried on one side. Who ever said breakfast can’t be simple and tasty at the same time?

A puffball mushroom is coated in batter and flour, then dipped into boiling oil and sprinkled with salt. A truly unique dish — crisp and firm on the outside, yet soft and tender within. After a snack like this, work feels much easier.
description.concoction.concoction.fungus: A handful of fungi boiled together. Their smell and taste make it clear — you’d better eat this only if there’s absolutely nothing else around. The bitter, sharp flavor might grant some experience… though who knows what side effects these strange mushrooms could bring?
description.concoction.concoction.glowbe: A slice of glowing jelly cake. Surprisingly, it isn’t overly sweet — its flavor is closer to sponge ice cream, and the jelly-like texture makes every bite delightfully curious. The berries shimmer inside like tiny lights, and anyone who tastes this dessert can’t help but shine with joy.
description.concoction.concoction.golden: Corn coated with a generous layer of gold. Hardly a delicacy, but they say it helps you slip away from trouble. Just don’t count on eating it mid-battle.
description.concoction.concoction.hanami: Three colorful rice dumplings on a stick, each with its own flavor. Their soft, sticky texture and gentle sweetness bring to mind the warmth of spring and the blooming of cherry trees. It’s said that in some villages, this dessert is made to celebrate the arrival of spring.
description.concoction.concoction.hashbr: Thick potato cakes that crunch pleasantly and carry a warm, pine-scented aroma. Just the thing for those who’ve only just woken up.
description.concoction.concoction.honey_: The name says it all. Juicy roasted corn coated in a thick layer of caramelized, flowing honey and sugar. It’s hard to hold without getting sticky—or dripping on the ground. Still, it fills the stomach quickly and restores your strength.
description.concoction.concoction.hot_ch: Bittersweet chocolate melted into milk, enriched with cream and sugar. Its bitterness is long gone—replaced by a thick, warm sweetness that fills your stomach to the brim. The creamy chocolate aroma makes any meal feel richer. A perfect harmony of flavors.
description.concoction.concoction.hot_sa: A bottle of very spicy, yet incredibly tasty sauce. An ingredient used in certain dishes. It’s said that food seasoned with this sauce can cure any ailment.
description.concoction.concoction.kozina: A sweet made from roasted sunflower seeds bound together with hardened honey. A small golden brick filled with sunlight and sugar! After a treat like this, you’ll surely feel like going for a walk. Children of some villages love this treat.
description.concoction.concoction.lingon: A slice of lingonberry and cream cake. Several soft layers soaked in fresh cream and the flavor of ripe berries. It’s impossible to stop — you could eat this dessert forever. The way the sweetness of the berries melts into the creamy flavor is beyond words! After a treat like this, everything else seems to taste better.
description.concoction.concoction.meat_g: Large chunks of meat are seared first, followed by the vegetables, before everything is combined. Broth is then added and simmered until thick and rich. After such a long and patient process, the meat turns wonderfully tender and flavorful, its aroma spreading far and wide. A dish sure to heal even the hungriest of souls.
description.concoction.concoction.mint_b: A strong brew made from fresh mint. Refreshes, warms, and helps you recover. This icy aroma is truly unforgettable. After all, mint truly is good for your health.
description.concoction.concoction.mint_c: A slice of mint chocolate cake. The gentle cream flavored with cool mint blends perfectly with the soft chocolate sponge. Its refreshing aroma and sweet aftertaste make you forget everything—except the next bite. A perfect treat for those who crave the balance of mintiness and recovery.

Mint has long been known for its healing properties. The sea-green hue and gentle aroma of this soft cookie are proof that taking a few mint cookies was a wonderful idea. Refreshes the senses and leaves your breath pleasantly cool.
description.concoction.concoction.minty_: A minty, cool jelly dessert. Refreshing and restorative thanks to its crisp mint flavor. Just try not to think too hard about where the jelly came from.
description.concoction.concoction.mushro: The ingredients are first boiled until tender, then blended into a thick consistency and warmed with cream — creating a rich, flavorful soup. A simple way to enjoy a hot treat that makes any meal better.
description.concoction.concoction.nishol: A thick, creamy dessert that looks much like jam. Its sweet flavor fills the stomach quickly, and its soft shimmer seems to enhance the taste of anything it touches. Who would’ve thought soap could taste this good? Quite a few of villages like this dessert.
description.concoction.concoction.noodle: Soft noodles generously covered in creamy sauce. The warm scent of milk and herbs makes this dish wonderfully gentle and comforting. After a bowl like this, everything tastes better and softer.

A bowl of fragrant noodles served with juicy meatballs. The thick sauce coats both the noodles and the meat, creating a rich flavor that’s hard to resist. Hearty and simple — the perfect meal after a long journey or to heal your soul.
description.concoction.concoction.obsidi: A mysterious bottle filled with dark purple liquid, thick and creamy in texture. You could try adding it to a dish… but is the risk worth it? A faint glow seeps from the bottle, almost whispering not to drink it—lest you end up somewhere you shouldn’t be.
description.concoction.concoction.omuric: A fluffy omelet covering a bed of fragrant fried rice with vegetables. The soft egg wraps the rice gently, topped with a touch of sweet sauce. Simple yet wonderfully comforting — a meal that helps start a very good morning.
description.concoction.concoction.onion_: A thick onion soup with a gentle, slightly sweet aroma. The onions are slowly sautéed until golden and soft, then simmered in broth for a deep, rich flavor. Hot, fragrant, and wonderfully comforting — the kind of soup that warms you even after the coldest day.
description.concoction.concoction.reappe: This pepper earned its name for a reason. After adapting to otherworldly soil, it changed—becoming far hotter and more dangerous than before. They say if you hold it close to your ear, you can hear faint whispers, growing louder as the night deepens. Best not to imagine what happens to it at midnight... or to find out. Surprisingly, it burns well—but if you decide to eat it, be careful not to burst into flames yourself.
description.concoction.concoction.spicy_: Red and fiercely hot pepper. An ingredient used in many dishes. Its spiciness isn’t for everyone, but it helps drive away bad vibes. They say meals made with it are fiery—yet can cure many ailments.
description.concoction.concoction.stir_f: Slices of meat seared over high heat, mixed with finely chopped pepper and onion, and drenched in a generous dose of hot sauce. After a meal like this, you’ll feel so warm you might just melt—though any bad feeling will burn away too… along with your tongue.
description.concoction.concoction.sweet_: A sweet, cool jelly dessert. Refreshing and filling—perfect for anyone with a sweet tooth. Just try not to think too hard about where the jelly came from.
description.concoction.concoction.vegeta: A vegetable soup made from a mix of ingredients. Simple, cheap, and warmly comforting — a true classic.
description.concoction.concoction.tomato: A hot stew made from finely chopped tomatoes and assorted vegetables. Its slightly salty sauce gives it a rich, flavorful texture. A dish that warms you up and makes any work feel a little easier.
description.concoction.concoction.sunflo: A very strong brew made from sunflower and its seeds. For some reason, its sickly yellow color makes you uneasy... The oily scent and flavor aren’t to everyone’s liking, but if you manage to finish it, it feels as though the sun itself blesses you — your strength won’t fade until sunset. Sadly, it won’t save you from feeling unwell.
description.concoction.minecraft.chorus_: A strange fruit with a distorted flavor, growing in another world. It has no scent and a tough outer skin. It seems there wasn’t much light or nourishment where it grew. One bite makes your head spin and your vision blur… wonder what happens if you eat the whole thing?
description.concoction.minecraft.glow_be: Berries that softly glow in the dark. Sweet and juicy, as if they absorbed the moonlight itself. They’ll make anyone shine with joy.
description.concoction.minecraft.melon_s: A juicy slice of melon — sweet and refreshing. Perfect for quenching thirst on a hot, sunny day.
description.concoction.minecraft.sweet_b: A handful of bright red berries. Sweet with a hint of tartness, but be careful — the bushes they grow on bite back! They love the cool and their fresh flavor fills your belly fast.
description.concoction.minecraft.pumpkin: A fragrant pumpkin pie with a soft filling. The warm taste of autumn, bringing own sweetness even on the coldest night.
description.concoction.minecraft.cookie: A crunchy, sweet cookie with chocolate chips — a small piece of happiness. Very sweet and crumbly… easy to ruin your appetite with.
description.concoction.minecraft.honey_b: A bottle of thick honey — sweet, golden, and warm, as if the sun itself hid inside the glass. It’s said to neutralize certain poisons, and its sweetness fills you up fast.
description.concoction.minecraft.apple: A fresh red apple — crisp and juicy. Simple yet delightfully sweet. Eat it as is, or use it in a recipe — it’ll taste great either way.
description.concoction.minecraft.golden_: An apple coated with a thin layer of gold. Sweet, with a faint metallic aftertaste. A reliable companion in hard times, making you tougher.
description.concoction.minecraft.enchant: An apple covered in a shimmering layer of gold. Overly sweet, with a metallic hint. Helps you through the toughest moments, granting incredible resilience.
description.concoction.minecraft.golden_: A carrot coated in gold. Crunchy, slightly sweet, and surprisingly nourishing. They say gold makes any food more potent.
description.concoction.minecraft.rabbit_: A hearty stew of rabbit and vegetables. Thick and fragrant — the perfect meal for a traveler resting by the fire to regain strength.
description.concoction.minecraft.beetroo: A small root vegetable with gentle sweetness and an earthy aroma. Simple, but remarkably good for your health.
A thick beetroot soup. Its rich color, warm aroma, and subtle sweetness create a wonderfully homely taste. Full of nourishment, it can sustain you even through hard times.
description.concoction.minecraft.pufferf: A dangerous fish with a spiky attitude. It must be prepared with care — one mistake, and surviving the poison would be a miracle. Best not to risk it unless you trust your skill… or your luck.
description.concoction.minecraft.dried_k: A strip of dried kelp. Salty and light — it nourishes the body, though the taste isn’t for everyone. Still, it’s surprisingly helpful before hard work.
description.concoction.minecraft.potato: A simple potato — humble yet versatile. It can be cooked a hundred ways, and all of them delicious. Raw, however, it offers nothing but a bitter lesson.
description.concoction.minecraft.poisono: A strange, slightly green potato. Its taste is questionable — best not to eat it, unless curiosity gets the better of you. The experience will surely be bitter.
description.concoction.minecraft.suspici: A stew that smells oddly mysterious. No one really knows what went into it, but there’s definitely some magic involved. Bitter, unpredictable… and dangerously intriguing.
description.concoction.concoction.pumpki: A fragrant slice of pumpkin pie with a soft filling. The warm taste of autumn, bringing own sweetness even on the coldest night.
description.concoction.concoction.tahchi: A large serving of tahchin. The meat is marinated in yogurt, then mixed with cooked rice and baked until a crispy crust forms. Before serving, it is often topped with dried fruits. The combination of meat and rice is very filling, which is why tahchin is so popular in some villages. Heals your soul and warms you heart.

A small serving of tahchin. The meat is marinated in yogurt, then mixed with cooked rice and baked until a crispy crust forms. Before serving, it is often topped with dried fruits. The combination of meat and rice is very filling, which is why tahchin is so popular in some villages. Heals your soul and warms you heart.
